title: Sweep status
description: The state of a sweep: one recipe composed into one run per sensor. A sweep has no state of its own; it reports the state of each of its runs, and a run that fails or is cancelled does not affect the others.

sweep_id.description: The sweep id: the sha256, as 64 lowercase hex digits, of the canonical JSON serialization (RFC 8785) of the sorted array of the sweep's run ids. A sweep is identified by the runs it contains, so any recipe that composes to the same runs names the same sweep.

recipe.description: The recipe the sweep was first submitted from.

name.description: The recipe's name in the library (its file stem), or null if the recipe was submitted as a document.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the recipe's bytes, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

runs.description: The status of each run, in the order of the recipe's sensor list.
